import pathlib,os,fcntl,json,hashlib,shutil,subprocess,datetime
parent=pathlib.Path('/var/backups/proofofwork-ui/rollback-roots')
keep=parent/'proofofwork-www-pre-0e767c69e785-20260929T165314Z'
lock=open('/run/proofofwork-ui/deploy.lock','a');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
expected={'/var/www':'0e767c69e785-20260929T165314Z',str(keep):'d2c0afaffd9c-20260929T161019Z'}
for root,release in expected.items():
 p=pathlib.Path(root);m=dict(l.split('=',1) for l in (p/'.proofofwork-ui-release').read_text().splitlines() if '=' in l)
 assert m['release_id']==release
 a=pathlib.Path('/var/backups/proofofwork-ui/releases')/m['archive_name'];h=hashlib.sha256()
 with a.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
 assert h.hexdigest()==m['archive_sha256']
 for k,v in m.items():
  if not(k.startswith('surface.') and k.endswith('.sha256')):continue
  surface=k.split('.')[1];d=p/('proofofwork-'+surface);paths=[]
  for base,dirs,files in os.walk(d,followlinks=False):
   assert not any((pathlib.Path(base)/n).is_symlink() for n in dirs+files)
   paths.extend((pathlib.Path(base)/n).relative_to(d).as_posix() for n in files)
  digest=hashlib.sha256()
  for n in sorted(paths,key=lambda v:v.encode()):
   q=d/n;digest.update(n.encode()+b'\0'+format(q.stat().st_mode&0o7777,'o').encode()+b'\0'+hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest().encode()+b'\n')
  assert digest.hexdigest()==v and len(paths)==int(m['surface.'+surface+'.file_count'])
plan=[]
for p in sorted(parent.iterdir()):
 if p==keep:continue
 assert p.name.startswith('proofofwork-www-pre-') and p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink()
 assert not os.path.ismount(p)
 manifest=(p/'.proofofwork-ui-release').read_text()
 plan.append({'root':str(p),'manifest':manifest,'manifestSha256':hashlib.sha256(manifest.encode()).hexdigest()})
assert len(plan)==16
# No process cwd/root/executable or open descriptor may reference a retired tree.
for proc in pathlib.Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*'):
 for ref in [proc/'cwd',proc/'root',proc/'exe',*list((proc/'fd').glob('*'))]:
  try:target=os.readlink(ref)
  except OSError:continue
  assert not any(target==r['root'] or target.startswith(r['root']+'/') for r in plan),target
for p in pathlib.Path('/var/www').rglob('*'):
 if p.is_symlink():assert not any(str(p.resolve()).startswith(r['root']+'/') for r in plan)
receipt=pathlib.Path('/var/backups/proofofwork-ui/cleanup-evidence/audit28-rollback-roots-20260929.json')
assert not receipt.exists()
receipt.write_text(json.dumps({'approvedBy':'User audit28 cleanup approval','preserved':expected,'plan':plan},indent=2));os.chmod(receipt,0o600)
with receipt.open('rb') as f:os.fsync(f.fileno())
for row in plan:
 shutil.rmtree(row['root'])
 print(json.dumps({'removed':row['root']}),flush=True)
print(subprocess.check_output(['df','-B1','/'],text=True))
